mission: 1.69 — Independent Product-Relevant Quantity Class Selection V1

class_is_not_a_construct.statement: A quantity class is broader than a construct. This mission selects a class; a later mission freezes the exact proposition. No exact header, technology, keyword or threshold is chosen here.

classes.name: additional class
classes.why: §19 permits one more only if evidence reveals a substantially better route, and §3 forbids weak filler. Nothing read this mission revealed a class with better two-route plausibility than Q1, and proposing one to reach a count would be manufacturing a candidate.
